svg.title: Same functional score, different repeated spending
svg.desc: The top panel counts all one hundred six pairs with complete API-equivalent cost in five ratio bins. The bottom dumbbells show every one of the twenty pairs whose expensive-to-cheap cost ratio exceeds one point five; each endpoint is an actual repetition and is labeled with its cost. All one hundred eight repeated task pairs are accounted for, including two incomplete-cost pairs listed separately. There are only two repetitions per setting, so no confidence intervals are asserted.
svg.text: The same functional score can cost different amounts
105/106 complete-cost pairs have identical main grades; 20 cost ratios exceed 1.5x
All complete-cost pairs: larger / smaller actual repetition cost
Every pair above 1.5x - endpoints are actual costs, sorted by ratio
Two pairs have incomplete cost, so no exact spending ratio is calculated:
Sol 6 Max / SQLite - recorded observations remain in the archive.
Sol 6 Ultra / Intervals - recorded observations remain in the archive.
Circles: r1. Squares: r2. Two observations describe this sample; no confidence intervals or forecast are claimed.
